questions.question: 结对编程：为一份法律文档编写 chunker，要求绝不拆分条款，并且携带足够的上下文，使检索到的 chunk 能够自包含。
questions.questionEn: Paired coding: write a chunker for a legal document that never splits a clause and carries enough context that a retrieved chunk is self-contained.

questions.question: 一位律师问的是一份 200 页的信贷协议，其中第 140 页的关键条款依赖于第 8 页的一个定义术语。你会如何构建能正确处理这一点的 retrieval？
questions.questionEn: A lawyer asks about a 200-page credit agreement where the operative clause on page 140 depends on a defined term on page 8. How do you build retrieval that gets this right?

questions.question: 什么时候你会把整份合同放进 context window，而不是对它做 retrieval？请用数据论证你的回答。
questions.questionEn: When would you put a whole contract in the context window instead of retrieving over it? Defend the answer with numbers.

sources.title: LLM 中的 lost-in-the-middle 问题

questions.question: 设计一个 agent：输入一份 NDA 草稿，返回一份体现该律所 playbook 的带修订标记的 Word 文档，而不是一段聊天回复。
questions.questionEn: Design an agent that takes a draft NDA and returns a redlined Word document reflecting the firm's playbook, not a chat response.

questions.question: 介绍一个工作流的架构：它依据一份 18 个问题的尽调清单审查 5,000 份合同，并返回一张审查网格。
questions.questionEn: Present the architecture for a workflow reviewing 5,000 contracts against an 18-question diligence checklist, returning a review grid.

questions.question: 一个新的前沿模型发布了，在你的 benchmark 上得分更高。在它触达客户之前，会发生什么？
questions.questionEn: A new frontier model is released and scores better on your benchmarks. What happens before it reaches customers?

questions.topicName: 安全、安保与负责任 AI
questions.question: Harvey 的每个回答中的每一条断言都需要链接回某个具体段落。请设计这套 grounding 系统，并告诉我你会如何衡量无支撑断言率。
questions.questionEn: Every assertion in a Harvey answer needs to link back to a specific passage. Design the grounding system, and tell me how you would measure the unsupported-claim rate.

questions.topicName: 安全、安保与负责任 AI
questions.question: 一次 agentic 研究查询返回了一份备忘录，其中引用了一个已被推翻的判例。这个问题会在哪里被拦截住？
questions.questionEn: An agentic research query returns a memo citing a case that was overruled. Where does that get caught?

questions.topicName: 安全、安保与负责任 AI
questions.question: 同一家律所的两位合伙人在一笔交易中处于对立双方。在常规多租户之上，为这种情况设计数据隔离。
questions.questionEn: Two partners at the same firm are on opposite sides of a deal. Design the data isolation for that, on top of normal multi-tenancy.

questions.question: 估算在包含 5,000 份文档的 data room 上运行你的尽调工作流的成本与周转时间，并告诉我你会最先拉动哪个杠杆。
questions.questionEn: Estimate the cost and turnaround of running your diligence workflow over a 5,000-document data room, and tell me which lever you'd pull first.

questions.question: 一位合伙人反馈，Harvey 漏掉了它审查的一份合同中的控制权变更条款。请排查这个问题。
questions.questionEn: A partner reports that Harvey missed a change-of-control clause in a contract it reviewed. Debug it.
